title: Herbal Crumbly Indian Prunes Crumble
description: A vibrant, dairyfree crumble that blends sweet prunes with warm Indian spices for an energizing dessert.
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the chopped prunes, coconut milk, brown sugar, cardamom, cinnamon, and ginger; stir until the prunes are evenly coated and let sit for 5 minutes to release their juices.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, and melted coconut oil until a crumbly mixture forms; add the pistachios if using.
Layer the prune mixture into a 20 × 20 cm baking dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula.
Evenly sprinkle the crumb mixture over the prunes.
Bake for 18–20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the prunes are bubbling.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, optionally drizzled with a splash of coconut milk or a dusting of powdered sugar if desired.
